Tests understanding of which anticancer drug inhibits which specific enzyme target, anchored after the block describing antimetabolites and targeted agents with their biochemical mechanisms.

Tests ability to identify HIV-encoded proteins and enzymes — each a drug target or diagnostic marker — among host and viral terms, anchored after the block on the HIV life cycle, drug targets and AIDS biochemistry.
